However, that memory is a single archived instance and doesn't address performance under tight capacity conditions like today's 94% committed volume with no buffer — a scenario where any onboarding hiccup or delivery variance could halt the line. I verify memory_c2 to check whether the original record notes any caveats about ramp-up time, quality consistency, or delivery reliability during the transition period, since those directly bear on delivery risk under a no-buffer constraint.
